question:
**Direction: Select the option with the correct spellings to replace the underlined words in the given sentence.**

There was an **__anouncement __**by the director of the company that __**grabed** __the attention of all the employees.
solution:
The correct answer is **"announcement; grabbed."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct spelling of the word is** 'announcement'** with double **'n' **and **'e.'**
 
• **"Announcement" **means a statement that tells people about something. (घोषणा, ऐलान, सूचना)
 
 
• **Example**: *She made an **announcement**__.*
 
 
 
• The correct past tense of **'grab'** is **'grabbed'** with double **'b.'**
 
• **"Grabbed"** means to take something with a sudden movement. (झपटकर किसी चीज़ को पकड़ना; छीनना)
 __
 
• **Example**: *She **grabbed**__ my hand.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

 

**Correct sentence**: *There was an __**announcement**__ by the director of the company that __**grabbed**__ the attention of all the employees. *
